# Mushafuk — Arabic tafsirs

> Arabic Quran commentaries, ayah by ayah, at https://tafsir.mushafuk.online. Part of Mushafuk (https://mushafuk.online). Free, no ads.

This host publishes Arabic tafsir as static HTML. Each book has a catalogue page and one page per ayah that has text in that book. When a commentary covers a group of ayahs, the full text is on the first ayah of the group.

## Start here

- [Catalogue](https://tafsir.mushafuk.online/)
- [All tafsirs on one ayah](https://tafsir.mushafuk.online/all/)
- [Madinah mushaf](https://mushafuk.online/)
- [Tafsir overview](https://mushafuk.online/tafsir.html)
- [FAQ](https://tafsir.mushafuk.online/faq.html)

## Books

- [Aysar al-Tafasir](https://tafsir.mushafuk.online/aysar/) — Abu Bakr al-Jaza'iri
- [al-Mukhtasar fi al-Tafsir](https://tafsir.mushafuk.online/mukhtasar/)
- [al-Tafsir al-Muyassar](https://tafsir.mushafuk.online/muyassar/)
- [Ibn Uthaymeen](https://tafsir.mushafuk.online/uthaymeen/)
- [Adwa' al-Bayan](https://tafsir.mushafuk.online/shinqiti/) — al-Shinqiti
- [Taysir al-Karim al-Rahman](https://tafsir.mushafuk.online/saadi/) — al-Sa'di
- [Mahasin al-Ta'wil](https://tafsir.mushafuk.online/qasimi/) — al-Qasimi
- [Fath al-Qadir](https://tafsir.mushafuk.online/shawkani/) — al-Shawkani
- [Ibn Kathir](https://tafsir.mushafuk.online/ibnkathir/)
- [Ibn al-Qayyim](https://tafsir.mushafuk.online/qayyim/)
- [Zad al-Masir](https://tafsir.mushafuk.online/jawzi/) — Ibn al-Jawzi
- [Ma'alim al-Tanzil](https://tafsir.mushafuk.online/baghawi/) — al-Baghawi
- [al-Sam'ani](https://tafsir.mushafuk.online/samani/)
- [Ibn Abi Zamanin](https://tafsir.mushafuk.online/zamanin/)
- [Ibn Abi Hatim](https://tafsir.mushafuk.online/ibnhatim/)
- [Jami' al-Bayan](https://tafsir.mushafuk.online/tabari/) — al-Tabari
- [Sufyan al-Thawri](https://tafsir.mushafuk.online/thawri/)

## Addresses

- One book, one ayah: https://tafsir.mushafuk.online/{id}/{surah}/{ayah}/
- Book ids: aysar, mukhtasar, muyassar, uthaymeen, shinqiti, saadi, qasimi, shawkani, ibnkathir, qayyim, jawzi, baghawi, samani, zamanin, ibnhatim, tabari, thawri
- All of those books on one ayah: https://tafsir.mushafuk.online/all/{surah}/{ayah}/
- Example: https://tafsir.mushafuk.online/saadi/1/1/

Further Arabic tafsirs are on https://t2.mushafuk.online/. Books on ulum al-Quran and usul are on https://t3.mushafuk.online/.

## Languages

The tafsir text is Arabic. Short FAQ pages also exist in Azerbaijani, English, Russian, and Turkish.
